title: Japanese for Izakaya in 9 Comic Scenes | Guess, Listen, Say It (Travel Japanese)
lead: Getting a table, ordering draft beer, the surprise starter, food, refills and the bill, everything for a Japanese izakaya in nine comic scenes. Guess first, then listen twice and say it.
tags: how to order beer in japanese

intro.title:
Japan izakaya
**9 phrases**
intro.say: Nine scenes in a Japanese izakaya. Guess each line before the answer.

phrases.label: Any seats?
phrases.ja: 二人ですが、空いていますか？
phrases.pron: Futari desu ga, aite imasu ka?
phrases.ko: There are two of us. Do you have a table?
phrases.when: Walking in without a booking? Ask like this.
phrases.tip: Aite imasu ka means is anything free. For three people, start with sannin desu ga.
phrases.scene: At the entrance, Jiwoo pushes aside the plain fabric curtain and holds up two fingers with a hopeful look; the server inside turns with a cheerful grin; Minjun peeks in behind her.

phrases.label: Ordering draft beer
phrases.ja: 生ビールを二つください。
phrases.when: Once you sit down, the server asks about drinks first. For two draft beers, say this.
phrases.tip: Nama-biiru is draft beer. One is hitotsu, three is mittsu.
phrases.hear: お飲み物は何になさいますか？ (Onomimono wa nani ni nasaimasu ka?) = What would you like to drink?
phrases.short: Your first order at a Japanese izakaya
phrases.scene: Seated at a small wooden table, Jiwoo holds up two fingers and mimes lifting a beer mug; the server stands on the right holding a small order pad; Minjun nods eagerly.

phrases.label: What is this?
phrases.when: A little dish you didn't order just arrived? Ask this.
phrases.tip: It is called otoshi, a small starter. It usually works like a table charge on your bill.
phrases.short: A dish you didn't order in an izakaya?
phrases.scene: The server places a tiny bowl of a simple side dish in front of Jiwoo; Jiwoo points at it with a surprised, curious face; Minjun leans in to look.

phrases.label: Non-alcoholic drinks
phrases.ja: ノンアルコールの飲み物はありますか？
phrases.pron: Non-arukooru no nomimono wa arimasu ka?
phrases.when: If someone in your group doesn't drink, ask this.
phrases.tip: Most places also have oolong tea, uuron-cha, and juice.
phrases.scene: Jiwoo gestures toward Minjun, who makes a small cross with his arms and a sheepish smile, and asks the server, who holds up a glass of tea on a tray.

phrases.label: Ordering a platter
phrases.ja: 焼き鳥の盛り合わせをください。
phrases.when: Want to try a bit of everything? Order a platter.
phrases.tip: Moriawase means an assortment. A sashimi platter is sashimi moriawase.
phrases.scene: Jiwoo points at a picture of skewers on a menu card (no readable writing) and smiles at the server, who writes on his pad.

phrases.label: Same again
phrases.ja: 同じものをもう一つください。
phrases.pron: Onaji mono o mou hitotsu kudasai.
phrases.ko: One more of the same, please.
phrases.when: Want another of the same drink? Hold up your empty glass and say this.
phrases.tip: Onaji mono means the same thing. It works for food too.
phrases.scene: Jiwoo holds up her empty beer mug with one finger raised; a plate of grilled chicken skewers sits on the table; the server gives a thumbs-up on the right.

phrases.label: Last orders
phrases.ja: ラストオーダーは何時ですか？
phrases.pron: Rasuto oodaa wa nanji desu ka?
phrases.when: Planning to stay late? Ask when last orders are.
phrases.tip: After last order you cannot order more. Staff often tell you when it is coming.
phrases.scene: Later in the evening, Jiwoo taps her wristwatch and asks the server, who is clearing plates and answers with a friendly nod.

phrases.label: Paying separately
phrases.when: Want to split the bill? Ask this.
phrases.tip: Many izakaya prefer one bill per table. If so, one person pays and you split it.
phrases.scene: At the register by the door, Jiwoo points at herself and then at Minjun, each holding a wallet, and asks the server behind the register.

bonus.label: Cheers
bonus.when: Finally, when everyone clinks glasses, say this. You will hear it all evening in an izakaya.
bonus.scene: Jiwoo and Minjun clink their beer and tea glasses together with big smiles over the table full of food; the server on the right laughs and claps.

outro.title: Recap: **9 phrases**
outro.say: All the phrases are in the description. Tell us in the comments how many you got right. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
